text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of summer camp, a
period
of intense training during which
racers can
improve their skills.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer. Why don't we go put
our
luggage away? ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't give me that! Get your butt over
here!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Plenty of open space for our
meeting.
Looks like we made it here
first.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Of course not, dummy. Sure, I like to be number one, but that's not the only reason I do things.
choice_data_list: You wanted to be the first one her...
You wanted to be the first one here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta talk strategy somewhere
the others
won't overhear us, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now hurry up and come up with a plan! I
want to
make the most of summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
There's a lights-out rule, but no curfew,
so we can
keep training as late as we
want.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. I knew you were going to
say that.
choice_data_list: I won't let you overdo it.
I won't make you push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins my summer camp with
Daiwa
Scarlet!
